items.name: sse-channel
items.title: defineSseRoute (server) + useSseChannel (client)
items.description: Server-Sent Events helpers. defineSseRoute returns a route handler with heartbeat ping every 15s + cleanup on client abort. useSseChannel is the client subscriber with auto-reconnect + exponential back-off + JSON-parsing.

items.name: use-presence
items.title: usePresence (Upstash Redis-backed)
items.description: Active-viewer presence — beats a heartbeat endpoint on a configurable interval AND when the tab regains focus, polls a members endpoint for the live list. Returns `{ users, others, isLoading }`. Server endpoints sketched in the file's JSDoc.

items.name: use-channel
items.title: useChannel (transport-agnostic pub/sub)
items.description: Subscribe / publish on a named realtime channel, backed by `useSseChannel` for ingress and a simple POST to `/api/channels/:name` for egress. Returns `{ publish, lastMessage, status }`. Foundation for typing, comments, live cursors, lock takeovers.

items.name: typing-indicator
items.title: useTypingPublisher + <TypingIndicator>
items.description: Pair-up that broadcasts typing.start / typing.stop on a `useChannel` and renders 'Alice, Bob are typing…' with animated dots. Publisher debounces stop events so the indicator doesn't flicker between keystrokes.

items.name: collaborative-lock
items.title: useCollaborativeLock + <LockBanner> + <LockBadge>
items.description: Soft-lock primitive for collaborative documents. `useCollaborativeLock(channel, { me })` returns `{ state, holder, acquire, release, takeover }`. `<LockBanner>` shows 'Alice is editing — Take over' to others; `<LockBadge>` shows the holder in a row/list.

items.name: activity-broadcast
items.title: defineActivityBroadcaster (parallel-sink fanout)
items.description: Server-side helper. `defineActivityBroadcaster({ publish, persist, notify, onError })` returns a single `broadcast(event)` you call from any mutation. Fans the event out to SSE, the database, and the notification system in parallel via Promise.allSettled — one sink failing doesn't block the others.
